original_html: In all MC samples, \PYTHIA v8.205 was used for hadronization with tune CP5 [49]. The parton distribution function (PDF) set used in simulation is NNPDF3.1 at next-to-next-to-leading order in perturbative QCD [50]. Simulated minimum bias events are superimposed on the primary collision to mimic the impact of additional interactions that occur in the same or adjacent bunch crossings (pileup) [51].
